title: Pink Pucca Haired Girl
content:
## _Sieun Lee, an aspiring 3D character modeler, uses Marvelous Designer to bring realistic fabric details to life. Inspired by concept art, she focused on creating a charming monolid character with dynamic jacket folds. Marvelous Designer's real-time simulation and intuitive workflow have become essential in her creative process._

* * *

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/5a9501ca0bd4403eae3b50f17597f371/images/d2bf1746ad3a46658b3cce806a299a3f11.%20Pose4_7_1%2B3%283%29.png)

# **Interview with Sieun Lee | 3D Character Modeler**

* * *

# **Please provide a brief introduction of yourself as an artist and share what inspired your interest in the field of 3D design.**

Hello, my name is Sieun Lee, and I aspire to become a 3D character modeler. During high school, I was introduced to CAD, which sparked my fascination with 3D modeling. This naturally led me to explore 3D character modeling, and I have been passionate about it ever since.

# **Where did the idea for the “Pink Pucca Haired Girl” project originate? What aspects did you focus on during the design process?**

I wanted to create a monolid character with a bun hairstyle, so I searched for concept art and came across the work of 毒瘤 (<https://www.artstation.com/artwork/d8ZneA>) on ArtStation, which inspired me to bring this project to life. I focused on two key aspects during the design process:

A cute bob hairstyle that enhances the character's charm & Dynamic jacket folds that change naturally with the character’s movements, adding a sense of realism and fluidity.

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/5a9501ca0bd4403eae3b50f17597f371/images/5481f1e6ea3e4586bbefb322c8e7738401%20%281%29.jpg)

_Reference_

# **Why did you decide to use Marvelous Designer? How did it help in your workflow?**

I believe Marvelous Designer is unmatched when it comes to realistically simulating fabric textures. What intrigued me the most was its real-time simulation feature, which looked incredibly fun to work with.

The ability to create, dress, and instantly modify garments, almost like playing with dolls, was especially appealing. It made the design process more intuitive and efficient, allowing for quick adjustments and achieving natural-looking fabric dynamics with ease.

# **Can you briefly explain the overall production pipeline, including the use of Marvelous Designer?**

Since I wanted the jacket's folds to naturally adapt to different poses, I initially created a minimally wrinkled base jacket and applied animations afterward.

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/5a9501ca0bd4403eae3b50f17597f371/images/b06fa0e5b2444896882a80d345521d7301.jpg)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/5a9501ca0bd4403eae3b50f17597f371/images/d1086d4004084d098939ce05e6a6fc2902.jpg)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/5a9501ca0bd4403eae3b50f17597f371/images/68a89f49439c4fdebc6d62d4d79a669403.jpg)

Once the baking and texturing process was completed, I imported the mesh into Marvelous Designer and applied simulation over the animated pose. I then exported the simulation as an Alembic file, which I brought into 3ds Max. There, I used Morpher to blend the simulated results with the original mesh, finalizing the project.

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/5a9501ca0bd4403eae3b50f17597f371/images/596c218ae2cd42f18719ea6bfa2e716827.%20Wire1%2B%E1%84%8C%E1%85%B5%E1%84%87%E1%85%B3%E1%86%AF%E1%84%89%E1%85%A3%E1%86%BA1.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/5a9501ca0bd4403eae3b50f17597f371/images/40834de70e5d48c29cba084ad5c55a3a26.%20%E1%84%91%E1%85%A1%E1%84%8E%E1%85%B3%E1%84%8C%E1%85%B5%E1%84%87%E1%85%B3%E1%86%AF%E1%84%89%E1%85%A3%E1%86%BA1.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/5a9501ca0bd4403eae3b50f17597f371/images/16f878dffc0a421bb227cc38253423d625.%20Pose6%283%29.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/5a9501ca0bd4403eae3b50f17597f371/images/46276609638240aa89beecfb5a8a1fad29.%20ADS4.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/5a9501ca0bd4403eae3b50f17597f371/images/69c26cffc96b41e5861aecaa489749cf30.%20ASD.png)

# **Were there any unexpected challenges during the production process? How did you overcome them?**

The jacket's complex structure made the process more challenging compared to previous fabric projects. When I imported a low-polygon mesh with reconstructed topology into Marvelous Designer as a single pattern, I encountered an issue where the sleeve boundaries became blurry, unlike when using the sewing tool.

After multiple attempts, I found a solution by utilizing the Pin feature. By first securing the sleeve shape, I was able to stabilize its structure before refining the rest of the garment, ultimately resolving the issue.

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/5a9501ca0bd4403eae3b50f17597f371/images/ef5945fc04134c34acd26f8d209a338504.jpg)

# **Do you have any tips or insights on effectively using Marvelous Designer for character design?**

I still have a lot to learn, but when it comes to fabric and clothing design, I truly believe there is no better tool than Marvelous Designer. Its wrinkle simulation is incredibly powerful, allowing me to create exactly what I envision with ease.

For better control over fabric details, I recommend using the Freeze and Pin features during simulation to refine wrinkles more precisely. Additionally, when working on complex garments, it's best to progress step by step and save frequently to avoid any setbacks.

# **Are there any new styles or areas you would like to explore using Marvelous Designer in the future?**

In the future, I would love to create dresses and ballet costumes. With Marvelous Designer, I believe I can achieve the elegant and voluminous drapes that are essential to these designs quickly and beautifully.

# **How has your overall experience been with Marvelous Designer? How has it influenced your workflow, and are there any features you particularly like or areas for improvement?**

Using Marvelous Designer has significantly improved my workflow efficiency. The fabric simulation feature, in particular, has saved me a tremendous amount of time compared to manually creating folds and wrinkles.

My favorite features are Strengthen and Solidify, which I use frequently. They allow me to precisely control fabric wrinkles in specific areas, making it much easier to achieve the desired look.

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/5a9501ca0bd4403eae3b50f17597f371/images/10285b5b3cea4a22af0b5786b401219315.%20Pose4_13%282%29.png)

# **_Link to_**[** _ArtStation_**](https://www.artstation.com/leesieun1)
content_description: Explore the creative journey of Sieun Lee, an aspiring 3D character modeler, as she utilizes Marvelous Designer to craft charming characters with realistic fabric details inspired by her artistic vision.

title: Trim Collision?
content:
Hi Everyone, I saw the video featuring the new trim collision feature in MD 2024.2. Unfortunately I cannot get that feature to work. All my trims, both imported or from the Connect store, have their collision options grayed out. I have not glued them to any cloth or other object in the scene. Am I missing a step somewhere or has this feature been disabled?

Thank you kindly!

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/57043c47130b4eb3bff7666a5e74f0d5/images/70f210266f434b3aa5f29afbd045c870collision1.png)


### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Great to know that your issue is fixed! If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to the community anytime!🍀

Comment 2: As of the 2024.2 version, the following features are not supported in Trim Simulation:* Collision handling between Trim and other Trims, Scene & Props, and Avatars* GPU simulation support* Animation recording supportWe apologize for the inconvenience and are planning to improve this aspect in the future. If you need any further assistance, feel free to ask!
Reply 1: Thank you! Switching to CPU simulation solved my issue!

Comment 3: Hello! I missed your post. Sorry for the late reply. Could you share images, or videos so that staff and other artists can see what they are experiencing and provide feedback? If you do not feel comfortable doing that, you can send a support ticket to Marvelous Designer's support team.
Reply 1: Hi Dahye,Thank you for the reply. I added a screenshot to the post. You can see that the collision properties for this default buckle are grayed out and cannot be selected. Fabric falls through it like it does not exist in a simulation. Note that the buckle has never been glued to any piece of fabric.
content_description: This web page aims to provide troubleshooting assistance and solutions for users experiencing issues with the trim collision feature in MD 2024.2.

title: Hello (안녕하세요) . Request Seamline intensity, Thickness normal map( 심라인을 강조하기 위한 노말맵 jpg를 요구합니다.)
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/437c5b82dc1f441e92b834a21f2e29de/images/ad3d2c60086545648ce4f4caf1f99e6d%E1%84%89%E1%85%B3%E1%84%8F%E1%85%B3%E1%84%85%E1%85%B5%E1%86%AB%E1%84%89%E1%85%A3%E1%86%BA%202025-02-20%20%E1%84%8B%E1%85%A9%E1%84%92%E1%85%AE%209.11.15.png)

I want to emphasis Seamline using Normal map. ( 100 intensity, 3.0 thickness)  
But, i don't know how can compose normal map.  
please let me know solution or give me thickness 3 , intensity 100 normal map jpg. Thank you for reading.  


안녕하세요 현재 CLO 를 사용하고 있는 한국 유저입니다. 제가 심라인을 강조하기 위해서 Normal map 을 통해 intensity와 thickness을 조절하고싶은데 쉽지가 않습니다.

CLO에서 기본값으로 구성을 해야하는 상황이기에 manual하게 조정하는것 외에 normal map을 직접 기본 파일에 구성한뒤에 사용하고자 합니다.

혹시 해당 질문에 대한 normal map을 만드는 방법을 아시거나, jpg 업로드를 통한 도움을 주신다면 진심으로 감사하겠습니다.


### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: 안녕하세요! 우선, 첨부 해주신 이미지상에서 봤을 땐 노멀맵이미지가 아닌 검은색이미지가 사용 되고 있습니다. 따라서 노멀냅 jpg 파일을 사용 해주셔야 하는데, CLO 우측의 라이브러리 창에서 Hardware and Trims -> Seamline 경로로 들어가시면 CLO에서 기본 제공하는 Seamline normal map이 첨부되어 있습니다. 해당 이미지 파일들을 드래그 해서 Property Editor창의 3D seamline - Normal map에 드롭 해서 사용 해주시면 됩니다. 만약, Hardware and Trims -> Seamline 경로에 해당 노멀맵 이미지가 없다면 라이브러리 창 우상단 토글키 중 Download를 눌러주시면 해당 이미지가 다운로드 됩니다!
Reply 1: 안녕하세요! 답변해주셔서 진심으로 감사드립니다 혹시 제가 노말맵을 구성하는것에 대한 기본 지식이없어서 thickness와 intensity의값을 지정하는 노말맵을 만드는방법이 어떤건지 여쭤봐도 될까요?
Reply 2: 안녕하세요. 노말맵은 3D 그래픽에서 물체의 표면 디테일을 표현하는 데 사용 되는 특수한 텍스처 이며, 물체의 표면에 있는 질감의 표현을 실제 지오메트리(메쉬의 변형 등)를 편집하지 않고도 표현이 가능하게 해줍니다. 노말맵은 보통 푸른색 계열의 색상으로 이루어진 이미지 파일이며, 질감의 빛 반사 각도(음각, 양각, 옆면 등)에 따라 푸른색의 정도가 바뀌거나 빨강, 초록 등의 색상이 추가 됩니다. CLO에서 Seamline Normalmap의 Thickness 값은 노말맵 이미지 적용 후 Seamline의 너비를 늘려주는 기능이며, Intensity 값은 Seamline의 깊이 정도를 조절 해주는 기능이라고 생각주시면 좋을 것 같습니다. 먼저 드린 답변의 경로에서 Seamline에 대한 CLO의 기본 노멀맵을 확인 하실 수 있으며, CLO가 아닌 다른 이미지 편집툴을 통해 제작된 노말맵 또한 CLO로 가져와서 사용 하실 수 있습니다. 노멀맵은 다양한 이미지 편집툴을 이용해서 제작이 가능하며, 주로 포토샵 프로그램을 이용해서 제작 하는 것이 가장 일반적인 방법으로 알려져 있습니다. (Seamline normalmap의 경우는 CLO 기본 제공 이미지를 사용 하시는 것을 가장 추천 드립니다.)
Reply 3: 바쁘실텐데 성심성의껏 답변해주셔서 진심으로 감사드립니다! 좋은 주말 보내셔요 !! :)
content_description: This web page aims to provide guidance and resources for creating a normal map with specific intensity and thickness settings to enhance seamline details in CLO software.
